sections.title: Introduction to Creative Writing: Fantasy and Magical Realism
sections.description: An introduction to writing fantasy and magical realism. Suitable for beginners or experienced writers who want to return to fundamentals. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.
